title: Field and Claim
thesis: The hero is a place: one cinematic, shallow-depth frame with a quiet zone where the claim and the name field live.

light: Natural single-direction light (low sun or overcast wrap); UI glass and borders take the same direction.
Atmospheric haze separates planes so depth reads before detail.
composition: Composed for the layout: the image reserves a calm zone for headline, sub and field before anything is generated.
85mm at f/1.4-2.4: one subject in focus, the rest falls into bokeh.
type: Claim centred or left on the quiet zone, white on scene with a scrim only where contrast needs it.
Field and CTA share one line under the claim.
motion: Very slow parallax or light change on the scene; the field never moves.
Scene stills first, then motion between certified key frames.
color: The camera finds the palette: the scene is graded toward one Jovie hue before capture or generation.
No people under UI; no text over faces.

tokenMap.jovie: Scene Palette v1 / imageColorPolicy.ts; one accent per page hero
homepage name search -> Find me (JOV-5085 lock); 28px pill CTA
art canon: single-shot 85mm bokeh focal rule
single-use hero background, abstract or place, never repeated across pages

antiGoals: Stock-photo landscapes with a desk prop.
Placing the field or any UI over a person.
Reusing a reference's scene, location or subject.
